title: Shrinking the unit cube to Q_δ while keeping half of an L¹ norm (parent step 4)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, Q₁ := {y ∈ Euclid (m + 1) : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i}, Q_δ := {y : δ < y_i < 1 − δ for all i}, and let f be integrable on Q₁. Then there is δ with 0 < δ ≤ 1/4, volume(Q_δ) ≤ 1, volume(Q₁ ∖ Q_δ) ≤ 1/4 and ∫_{Q₁}|f| ≤ 2∫_{Q_δ}|f|.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (f : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), IntegrableOn f {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ volume {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ} ≤ 1 ∧ volume ({y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} \ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}) ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |f y| ≤ 2 * ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, |f y|
